prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     Find object, approach it, take it, check properties, and do specific task. If not found, move randomly.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectNearby    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToRandomPosition    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectNearby? THEN
			DO GrabObject
	ELSE
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO SpecificTask
	END
